name: Amiable Logistics India Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2002, Amiable Logistics 
 (India) Ltd is in the business of Logistics[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ALIL offers services to importers and exporters for the clearance of all types of imports and exports by air and sea, serving as a bridge between trade entities and government authorities like Customs and DGFT.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.14 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.33% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.56 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -29.7%
